Name: HIT_EFFECT_SE_PARAM_ST
Description: Legacy hit sound table: row ID = the struck SE material (1-98), fields = attacker material x attack type x strength. Elden Ring does not load this param, so editing it has no effect: hit sounds are chosen by Wwise switches (see WwiseValueToStrParam: OffensiveMaterial, DeffensiveMaterial, AttackType, AttackStrength, DamageAmount, HitStop). Retail values follow a pattern: last two digits = an SE material, thousands digit 1 = large/giant, ten-thousands digit 0 slash / 1 thrust / 2 strike.
